about: The game's sound slots: everything the game plays, by name. Read by SoundKit (client3d/sound_kit.gd), which Sfx plays them through; tools/sound_status.gd writes docs/sound_status.md and THIRD_PARTY.md's sound block from it. A slot is played from, in order: its own takes in art/audio/<category>/<slot>/ (<slot>.ogg, <slot>.2.ogg ...; .wav too), named in 'source'; its fill, files of a third-party source (its 'path' + each of 'files'); its fallback, another slot; else a placeholder blip (a bed: silence). 'noise' is the sim's noise kind the sound goes with (World.noise; its radius is how far both monsters and players hear it); null means monsters do not hear it, and 'range' (cells) is how far players do. 'positional': false plays it flat (UI, beds). 'type' is oneshot, loop or bed; 'bus' is sfx, ambience, voice, ui or music.
